description: This file contains utility functions for handling session transcripts, including reading messages, extracting session metadata, managing cache, and parsing transcript content in a chat application context.

methods.name: attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta
methods.description: Attaches metadata to a message object under the __openclaw property.

methods.name: readSessionMessages
methods.description: Reads and parses session transcript messages from the stored transcript file.

methods.name: capArrayByJsonBytes
methods.description: Trims an array of items to fit within a maximum byte size when serialized as JSON.

methods.name: readSessionTitleFieldsFromTranscript
methods.description: Extracts the first user message and last message preview from a session transcript file.

methods.name: readFirstUserMessageFromTranscript
methods.description: Retrieves the first user message from a session transcript.

methods.name: readLastMessagePreviewFromTranscript
methods.description: Retrieves a preview of the last message in a session transcript.

methods.name: readLatestSessionUsageFromTranscript
methods.description: Extracts the latest usage statistics from a session transcript.

methods.name: readSessionPreviewItemsFromTranscript
methods.description: Generates preview items from recent session transcript messages for UI display.
